tasks.title: Brain beliefs filtered by channel of 1st order + prior global Kloel cold-start
tasks.prompt:
You are an OpenCode V4 Pro subagent. Repo: /Users/danielpenin/whatsapp_saas. Read CLAUDE.md. Never git restore.

MISSION: Parte 6.1 + 6.4 — beliefs in the brain filtered first by channel; when local sample < 30, use Kloel global prior with Bayesian weighting; workspaces can opt out of global prior.

FILES TO READ:
- backend/src/kloel/mind.service.ts (and adjacent mind-* files)
- backend/src/kloel/mind-belief.*.ts (if exists)
- backend/src/kloel/mind-policy.service.ts (policy.choose impl)
- backend/prisma/schema.prisma (find existing belief tables)

FILES YOU OWN:
- backend/prisma/schema.prisma (add KloelGlobalPrior model)
- backend/prisma/migrations/<ts>_kloel_global_prior/
- backend/src/kloel/kloel-global-prior.service.ts (new)
- backend/src/kloel/kloel-global-prior.service.spec.ts (new)
- backend/src/kloel/mind-policy.service.ts (consume global prior at cold start)
- backend/src/kloel/mind-belief-by-channel.ts (new helper to scope queries by channel)
- backend/src/kloel/mind-belief-by-channel.spec.ts (new)
- backend/src/workspace/workspace.service.ts (add globalPriorOptOut flag if missing)

SPEC:
1. KloelGlobalPrior model:
   model KloelGlobalPrior {
     id String @id @default(cuid())
     channel String
     decisionType String
     action String
     observations Int @default(0)
     successes Int @default(0)
     updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
     @@unique([channel, decisionType, action])
     @@index([channel, decisionType])
   }
2. KloelGlobalPriorService: getPrior(channel, decisionType, action) → { mean, observations } using Beta posterior; recordObservation(channel, decisionType, action, success).
3. mind-policy.service.choose():
   - When fetching local belief for {workspaceId, channel, decisionType, action}, if local observations < 30, mix with prior using Beta-Bayesian weighting (local_n * local_mean + global_n_weight * global_mean) / (local_n + global_n_weight), where global_n_weight = min(global_n, 30 - local_n).
   - If workspace.globalPriorOptOut === true, skip prior; use local-only with explicit fallback flag in result.decision.usedGlobalPrior=false.
   - Always record in decision.usedGlobalPrior: boolean + decision.priorWeight: number.
4. mind-belief-by-channel.ts: helper that always scopes belief queries with channel filter; no implicit fallback to 'any channel' — caller must pass channel.

VALIDATION:
  cd backend && npx prisma generate && npx prisma validate
  cd backend && npx jest --testPathPatterns='kloel-global-prior|mind-belief-by-channel|mind-policy' --no-coverage 2>&1 | tail -25
  cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -10

COMMITS:
- chore(prisma): KloelGlobalPrior model + migration (P6)
- feat(mind): channel-scoped belief queries (P6.1)
- feat(mind): global prior Bayesian mix for cold start (P6.4)
- feat(workspace): globalPriorOptOut flag

FINAL REPORT: prisma diff, sample posterior calculation, test count.

SPEC:
ContactIdentityResolverService.resolve({workspaceId, channel, externalId, phone?, email?, socialHandle?}) returns existing Contact or creates one. Merge logic:
1. Exact match on (workspaceId, channel, externalId) → return existing.
2. Cross-channel match by phone or email when present AND verified (existing Contact has matching channel record).
3. New Contact created with the channel record; identity remains separate from other channels until evidence (phone shared, email shared, or operator merges).
4. Identity events emitted to BrainEventSpine 'contact.identity_resolved' or 'contact.identity_merged'.

Orchestrator call: at orchestrateInbound entry, after channel normalization, call resolver and use the resolved contactId in subsequent operations.

tasks.title: Silent 24h outcome resolver (lead silenciou)
tasks.prompt:
You are an OpenCode V4 Pro subagent. Repo: /Users/danielpenin/whatsapp_saas. Read CLAUDE.md. Never git restore.

MISSION: Parte 11 — close 'silent_24h' outcomes for decisions that expected a reply within 24h but didn't get one.

NOTE: This task DEPENDS on the DecisionOutcome model being available (wave-2 task wave2-outcome-tracking). Read schema first; if DecisionOutcome doesn't exist, this task FAILS LOUD — print exact dependency message and exit with code 4. Do NOT proceed silently.

FILES YOU OWN:
- worker/processors/silent-24h-resolver.processor.ts (new)
- worker/processors/silent-24h-resolver.processor.spec.ts (new)
- worker/bootstrap.ts (register the new processor if needed)
- backend/src/queues/queue-keys.ts (add 'silent-24h-resolver' or similar)

SPEC:
- BullMQ repeat job every 5 min.
- Queries DecisionOutcome where outcomeAt IS NULL AND createdAt < NOW - expectedWindow hours.
- For each, checks if a 'inbound.received' event for the same contact happened after the decision createdAt. If yes, close as 'replied' with the existing logic (defer to DecisionOutcomeService.closeOutcome). If no AND expectedWindow elapsed, close as 'silent_24h' with economicValue=0 and wonVsBaseline depending on baselineAction.
- Emit BrainEventSpine 'outcome.silent_24h_closed' with contactId and outcomeKey.

VALIDATION:
  cd worker && npx jest --testPathPatterns='silent-24h-resolver' --no-coverage 2>&1 | tail -15
  cd worker && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -10

COMMITS:
- feat(worker): silent_24h outcome resolver job (P11)

FINAL REPORT: cron interval, sample outcome row before/after, test count.

tasks.title: PULSE re-cert runner script + GH workflow integration check
tasks.prompt:
You are an OpenCode V4 Pro subagent. Repo: /Users/danielpenin/whatsapp_saas. Read CLAUDE.md (PROTECTED: scripts/pulse/*, .github/workflows/*, .husky/* — do NOT edit). Never git restore.

MISSION: Add a developer runner that triggers a focused PULSE re-cert, validates output, and surfaces certification status — WITHOUT editing PULSE or CI configs.

FILES YOU OWN:
- scripts/dev/run-pulse-recert.sh (new — wraps existing PULSE CLI)
- scripts/dev/check-pulse-status.mjs (new — parses artifacts/pulse/PULSE_REPORT.md to extract certification status)
- docs/evidence/pulse-recert.md (new — explains how to interpret)
- AUDIT_FEATURE_MATRIX.md (UPDATE — sync each module's status from PULSE)

DO NOT EDIT:
- scripts/pulse/*
- .github/workflows/*
- ops/*
- scripts/ops/*
- .husky/*

SPEC:
run-pulse-recert.sh:
  #!/usr/bin/env bash
  set -euo pipefail
  echo 'Running PULSE re-cert...'
  npx ts-node --project scripts/pulse/tsconfig.json scripts/pulse/index.ts --report
  node scripts/dev/check-pulse-status.mjs

check-pulse-status.mjs reads PULSE_REPORT.md or artifacts/pulse/findings.jsonl, extracts:
- humanReplacementStatus (NOT_READY | READY_WITH_CAVEATS | READY)
- score
- count of breaks by severity
- list of caveats if READY_WITH_CAVEATS
Prints summary, exits 0 if READY/READY_WITH_CAVEATS, exit 1 if NOT_READY.

Doc must include: when to run, what each status means, how to interpret breaks.

VALIDATION:
  bash scripts/dev/run-pulse-recert.sh 2>&1 | tail -30
  (the script itself emits the eval; success criterion is non-zero exit indicates real NOT_READY, zero exit indicates READY-state)

COMMITS:
- feat(dev): pulse re-cert runner + status checker
- docs(evidence): pulse-recert reference
- chore(audit): sync AUDIT_FEATURE_MATRIX from PULSE

FINAL REPORT: current status from PULSE, count of breaks, list of caveats.
